gen-gf-bellota-gf-google-sans: Bellota's s hangs its ends far out from the spine, and every stroke keeps the width of a single stylus. Google Sans follows in a sans with no swelling in its curves and terminals pulled well back.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-google-sans-flex: Pen-drawn and unmistakable, Bellota leads with uniform strokes, while Google Sans Flex follows in a plain sans with ribbon-cut ends. Curves finish in clean, open gaps.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gothic-a1: Bellota's most striking habit is its s, with ends that hang far from the spine and strokes that never vary in width. Gothic A1 then takes over as a sans with barely any modulation and a splayed c terminal.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gotu: Bellota draws every stroke at the width of one stylus, giving its s ends that dangle far from the spine. And Gotu, a sans with sturdy hairlines and open-mouthed e crossbars, gains a gentle weight shift where its bowls curve.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gowun-dodum: Bellota is the distinctive voice here, its s ends hanging far from the spine in strokes of uniform width. Gowun Dodum is the sans that does the quiet work, with a wide-mouthed a and smooth, tube-like lines.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gruppo: Gruppo reads as a clean sans-serif whose curve endings never come near each other, which keeps every word clear. Bellota sits above it with strokes of unvarying thickness and a commanding s.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gudea: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota traces every stroke at the width of one stylus and lets its s ends hang far out. Gudea's thread-thin curves and glass-clear terminal gaps keep a plain sans easy going.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-hanken-grotesk: Hanken Grotesk looks wire-bent across each word, a plain sans with wide channels leading into every counter. Bellota above it adds a commanding s whose ends hang far from the spine.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-hubot-sans: Bellota's o is a ring with a constant wall, and its s ends hang far from the spine. Hubot Sans, a sans-serif with a widely opened e, keeps its own lines far less modulated.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: Hand-drawn and bold in attitude, Bellota keeps every stroke uniform, so no thick-thin flicker catches the eye. And IBM Plex Sans Arabic, a sans-serif with readily open apertures, carries a long passage along smoothly.
